headline: Argentina October Wholesale Inflation Rises 1.6% as INDEC Reports 29.8% Annual Rate
summary: Argentina's INDEC reported that the wholesale price index rose 1.6% in October, accumulating a 24.8% increase for the year and a 29.8% rise on an annual basis.
why: Wholesale inflation indices serve as a leading indicator for retail consumer price trends and macroeconomic stabilization progress in Argentina.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Monthly wholesale price increases measure ongoing inflationary pressures across the domestic economy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
